Notes to the Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026
1) The above statement of Consolidated Unaudited financial results (' The Statement") of Apollo Pipes Limited (“the Company”) for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, has been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors (" The Board") of the Company at their respective meetings held on November 5th, 2026.
2) The above Consolidated Financial Results are extracted from the un-audited consolidated financial statements, which are prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standard 34 (IND AS), as prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 and in terms of Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI Regulations).
3) During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary (WOS), Apollo Ceramics Limited, with 100% shareholding. Further, the newly incorporated wholly owned subsidiary acquired a 76% interest in "Mazzinni tiles LLP for a sum of Rs. 40.42 crs, thereby establishing an indirect controlling interest in the LLP through the Group. Accordingly, the financial statements of the wholly owned subsidiary and the LLP have been considered for consolidation in accordance with Ind AS 110 – Consolidated Financial Statements, from the respective dates on which control was obtained. The acquisition of the interest in the LLP has been evaluated under Ind AS 103 – Business Combinations, including assessment of whether the LLP constitutes a business. The accounting treatment has been determined in accordance with the applicable requirements of Ind AS.Details of purchase consideration, Fair value of Net Assets acquired and resultant Goodwill as at the acquisition date are as under:

4) The consolidated financial results includes results of it's subsidiary companies viz. "Kisan Moulding Limited"(including KML Tradelinks Private limited a subsidiary of Kisan Moulding Limited) and Apollo Ceramics Limited(including Mazzini Tiles LLP a step down subsidiary of Apollo Ceramics Limited).
5) The Company operates in one segment i.e. Manufacturing and Trading of Plastic Pipes, Fittings & Allied Products . Hence, no separate segment disclosures as per "Ind AS 108 : Operating Segments" have been presented.
6) The Board of Directors of the company at their meeting held on 26th June, 2026 approved the Scheme of arrangement amongst Apollo Pipes Limited(the Company), Kisan Moulding Limited (Subsidiary Company), KML Tradelinks Private Limited(Step-down Subsidiary). The Scheme is subject to approval of Stock Exchanges,National Company Law Tribunal, Shareholders and Creditors of the respective companies. The said Scheme is available at the website of the Company at www.apollopipes.com.
